label: Photographic look
description: How the photo was taken and finished, by intent: sharp throughout, candid, documentary, phone snapshot, polished, film, black and white, flash, soft background, old digital or motion. Choose the intent from the prompt; the list varies the wording.
notes: DRAFT. Each intent is a set of ways to say one thing; the writer picks the intent (where={"intent": ...}) and the draw varies the wording. Values name what is visible, never equipment or praise words (no 'cinematic', 'ultra-realistic', 'professional', f-numbers). Shares apply only when the prompt is silent: they are what keeps the default away from a blurred background. Closed, so generation can't bring the blur back. Supersedes camera.lens; camera.film_look folds into 'film', 'black_and_white' and 'old_digital'.
